verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents pre-built ML templates or images (PyTorch, CUDA, vLLM, ComfyUI) that a developer can launch from. The items cover GPU selection, containerized deployment in general and OpenAI-compatible endpoints, none of which is a template catalog. Templates are a fair axis for a GPU compute platform, so the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch from pre-built ML templates (PyTorch, CUDA, vLLM, ComfyUI) instead of assembling an environment from scratch
